root_cause_verification.rationale: Root cause was the ternary branch in ToolFullView.tsx that rendered ONLY SpecializedFullView for tools with registered specialized views (Edit, Agent), completely skipping generic Description/Input/Output sections. The fix changes this to sequential rendering: generic sections always render, specialized view renders in between Input and Output. Verified in browser that Agent tool now shows all sections.
